_about: Where Ubuntu's bash 5.2 (what the playground's bash follows) differs from the bash 3.2 that recorded expected.json on a Mac. The posix-bash suite uses these instead. Each entry names its reason.

061-glob-star.stdout:
a ab b c
a ab
ab b
.hidden
061-glob-star.why: bash 5.2 has globskipdots on by default, so .* does not match . and ..
